name: catia_add_component
description: Add an existing CATPart or CATProduct file as a component in the active assembly. The component is inserted at the origin.

file_path.description: Full path to the .CATPart or .CATProduct file to add

name: catia_add_new_part
description: Create a new empty Part directly inside the active assembly. Returns the name of the created component.

name.description: Name for the new part component

name: catia_fix_constraint
description: Fix a component in place (remove all degrees of freedom). Typically applied to the base/reference component.

component_name.description: Name of the component to fix

name: catia_coincidence_constraint
description: Create a Coincidence constraint between two components. Aligns axes, planes, or points of two components.

name: catia_offset_constraint
description: Create an Offset constraint between two faces/planes of two components. Maintains a constant distance between the reference elements.

name: catia_angle_constraint
description: Create an Angle constraint between two components.

name: catia_move_component
description: Move a component by translation and/or rotation. Translation in mm, rotation in degrees.

component_name.description: Name of the component to move

name: catia_list_components
description: List all components in the active assembly/product with their names and positions.

name: catia_list_constraints
description: List all assembly constraints in the active product.

name: catia_diagnose
description: Diagnose the running CATIA V5 installation: exact version, release and service pack, Python/pywin32 environment, and a probe of which automation APIs (Part Design ShapeFactory, GSD HybridShapeFactory, SPAWorkbench measurement) are actually exposed. Run this first when tools fail with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY, and include its output when reporting compatibility issues. Probing factories requires an active Part document; without one, only application-level info is reported.

name: catia_connect
description: Connect to CATIA V5. Attaches to a running instance or launches a new one. Must be called before any other CATIA tool.

name: catia_disconnect
description: Disconnect from CATIA V5 (does not close CATIA).

name: catia_new_part
description: Create a new empty Part document in CATIA V5. A Part is used for single-body 3D modeling (sketches + features).

name: catia_new_product
description: Create a new empty Product (assembly) document in CATIA V5. A Product is used to assemble multiple Parts together.

name: catia_open_document
description: Open an existing CATIA document from a file path (.CATPart, .CATProduct, .CATDrawing).

file_path.description: Full path to the CATIA document to open

name: catia_save_document
description: Save the active CATIA document. Optionally save to a new path (Save As).

file_path.description: Optional new file path for Save As

name: catia_close_document
description: Close the active CATIA document.

save.description: Whether to save before closing (default: false)

name: catia_list_documents
description: List all open documents in CATIA V5 with their types and paths.

name: catia_get_active_document_info
description: Get detailed info about the active CATIA document: name, type, path, part bodies, features, etc.

name: catia_new_drawing
description: Create a new empty Drawing document (CATDrawing) for generative drafting. The drawing becomes the active document; the source Part stays open and is referenced by catia_drawing_add_view.

name: catia_drawing_list_view_geometry
description: List the manually drawn 2D geometry of a drawing view as indexed elements for catia_drawing_add_dimension. Field-proven on V5R20: generated projection curves are NOT exposed here (GeometricElements shows only the axis and Factory2D items). To dimension generative views use catia_drawing_generate_dimensions. Defaults to the last view of the active sheet.

view_name.description: View to inspect (default: last view of the active sheet)

name: catia_drawing_add_dimension
description: Add a dimension between one or two manually drawn 2D elements (indices from catia_drawing_list_view_geometry). Works on Factory2D geometry only (R20: generated curves are not addressable); for generative views use catia_drawing_generate_dimensions.

type.description: Dimension type. 'length'/'radius'/'diameter' take one element; 'distance'/'angle' take two.

view_name.description: Target view (default: last view of the active sheet)

name: catia_drawing_generate_dimensions
description: Generate associative dimensions on a generative view from the part's 3D sketch constraints (one dimension per distance/length/angle/radius/diameter constraint). This is the only route that dimensions generated geometry in CATIA V5 (field-proven on R20): add constraints with catia_sketch_constraint, then call this. Reports the dimensions with values; generated ones follow the 3D model (status 3d_driven).

view_name.description: Target view (default: last view of the active sheet)

name: catia_drawing_list_dimensions
description: List the dimensions of a drawing view with their values and status (basic_2d or 3d_driven). Regenerates the view first so 3d_driven values reflect the current part (set refresh=false to skip).

view_name.description: View to inspect (default: last view of the active sheet)

refresh.description: Regenerate the view before reading (default true)

name: catia_drawing_projection_view
description: Add a projection view (right/left/top/bottom/rear) derived from an existing generative view, placed next to it at the same scale. DefineProjectionView with the documented CatProjViewType enum.

direction.description: Projection relative to the parent view

parent_view.description: Parent view name (default: last view of the active sheet)

gap.description: Distance from the parent view in mm (default 100)

x.description: Explicit X position in mm (overrides gap)

y.description: Explicit Y position in mm (overrides gap)

name: catia_drawing_section_view
description: Add a section view or section cut from a cutting profile drawn as a polyline in the parent view's 2D coordinates (mm). DefineSectionView per the V5 reference: profile points, section type, profile type, side to draw, parent view.

profile.description: Flat list [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...] of the cutting polyline in parent view coordinates (mm), at least two points

section_type.description: SectionView shows geometry behind the plane, SectionCut only the cut (default SectionView)

x.description: X position in mm (default: parent x + 150)

y.description: Y position in mm (default: parent y)

name: catia_drawing_detail_view
description: Add a circular detail view of a region of the parent view (center and radius in the parent view's 2D coordinates, mm). DefineCircularDetailView.

center_x.description: Circle center X in parent view coordinates (mm)

center_y.description: Circle center Y in parent view coordinates (mm)

x.description: X position in mm (default: parent x + 150)

y.description: Y position in mm (default: parent y + 100)

name: catia_drawing_add_text
description: Add a text annotation to a drawing view at (x, y) mm in the view's coordinate system (DrawingTexts.Add). Use the sheet's Background view for title block text.

view_name.description: Target view (default: last view; use 'Background View' for frames and title blocks)

name: catia_drawing_add_table
description: Add a table to a drawing view (DrawingTables.Add) and optionally fill its cells. Building block for title blocks, revision tables and BOMs: pass 'cells' as rows of strings, optional per-column widths, and the Background View as target for sheet-level tables.

column_widths.description: Optional per-column widths in mm (0 = automatic)

view_name.description: Target view (default: last view; use 'Background View' for title blocks)

name: catia_drawing_add_view
description: Add a generative front view of an open Part to the active Drawing's active sheet, projected on the chosen plane or on a planar face, then update it. Create the drawing first with catia_new_drawing; derive other views with catia_drawing_projection_view / section_view / detail_view. Field-validated on V5R20.

part_name.description: Open Part document to represent (e.g. 'Part1.CATPart'). Defaults to the only open Part when unambiguous.

body_name.description: Optional body to draw alone (e.g. 'PartBody' or 'Body.2'); other bodies are excluded. Field-validated on V5R20.

plane.description: Projection plane (default xy); ignored when 'face' is given

face.description: Face-driven projection: 'Face.N' of the body's final shape, as listed by catia_list_faces run with the SAME body_name; the view is projected on that planar face's own plane, orientation-independent. Field-proven on V5R20.

angle.description: In-plane rotation of the view in degrees (default 0)

x.description: View X position on the sheet in mm (default 300)

y.description: View Y position on the sheet in mm (default 150)

name: catia_export
description: Export the active document to a file. Supported formats: STEP (.stp), IGES (.igs), STL (.stl), 3DXML (.3dxml), VRML (.wrl), PDF (2D drawings).

file_path.description: Output file path. The format is determined by the extension. Example: 'C:/export/my_part.stp'

format.description: Export format (optional if file extension is provided). One of: step, iges, stl, 3dxml, vrml

name: catia_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the current 3D view and save as image file. Supports JPG, BMP, TIFF (CATIA V5 cannot capture PNG; a .png path is saved as .jpg instead).

name: catia_set_view
description: Set the 3D view orientation. Standard views: front, back, top, bottom, left, right, isometric.

name: catia_fit_all
description: Fit all geometry in the current 3D view (zoom to fit).

name: catia_gsd_create_geoset
description: Create a new Geometrical Set (HybridBody) in the active Part and make it the active target for subsequent GSD elements.

name.description: Name for the new geometrical set

name: catia_gsd_set_active_geoset
description: Select which Geometrical Set receives subsequently created GSD elements.

name.description: Name of an existing geometrical set

name: catia_gsd_list_elements
description: List all geometrical sets with their wireframe/surface elements and sketches, plus sketches in solid bodies. Use this to find element names for other GSD tools.

name: catia_gsd_point
description: Create a 3D point at (x, y, z). Coordinates in mm.

name: catia_gsd_line
description: Create a 3D line between two points. Each point is an existing element name or [x, y, z] coordinates.

oneOf.description: Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)
Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)

name: catia_gsd_plane_offset
description: Create a plane offset from a reference plane. Reference is 'xy', 'yz', 'zx', or the name of an existing plane element.

name: catia_gsd_plane_3points
description: Create a plane through three points (element names or [x,y,z]).

oneOf.description: Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)
Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)
Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)

name: catia_gsd_spline
description: Create a 3D spline through a list of points. Each point is an existing element name or [x, y, z] coordinates in mm.

oneOf.description: Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)

points.description: Points the spline passes through, in order

closed.description: Close the spline into a loop

name: catia_gsd_circle
description: Create a full 3D circle from a center point, a support plane, and a radius. Useful as a section for multi-sections surfaces.

oneOf.description: Name of an existing point element
[x, y, z] coordinates in mm (creates a new point)

name: catia_gsd_project
description: Project a curve/point onto a support surface or plane.

element.description: Name of the element to project

name: catia_gsd_intersection
description: Create the intersection of two elements (e.g. surface ∩ plane).

name: catia_gsd_multi_section_surface
description: Create a Multi-sections Surface (loft) through 2+ section curves (sketches, circles, splines...), optionally following guide curves. Sections should be listed in order along the lofting direction.

sections.description: Section curve element names, in lofting order

guides.description: Optional guide curve element names. Each guide MUST geometrically intersect every section, or the surface fails.

orientations.description: Optional per-section orientation, same length/order as sections. Set -1 for a section whose curve direction opposes the others (otherwise the loft twists or fails). Default: all 1.

name: catia_gsd_sweep
description: Create a swept surface by sweeping a profile curve along a guide curve (explicit sweep).

name: catia_gsd_extrude
description: Extrude a profile (curve/sketch) into a surface along a direction vector. limit1/limit2 are the extents on each side (mm).

name: catia_gsd_revolve
description: Revolve a profile curve around an axis line to create a surface of revolution. Angles in degrees.

name: catia_gsd_fill
description: Create a Fill surface bounded by a closed contour of curves (one closed curve or several connected curves).

boundaries.description: Boundary curve element names, in contour order

name: catia_gsd_blend
description: Create a Blend surface connecting two curves.

name: catia_gsd_offset_surface
description: Create a surface offset from an existing surface.

name: catia_gsd_join
description: Join (assemble) two or more curves or surfaces into one element.

name: catia_gsd_split
description: Split an element by a cutting element, keeping one side. Use orientation to flip which side is kept.

name: catia_gsd_trim
description: Mutually trim two elements, keeping one side of each. Use reverse flags to flip which sides are kept.

reverse1.description: Keep the other side of element1

reverse2.description: Keep the other side of element2

name: catia_gsd_symmetry
description: Mirror an element about a plane ('xy', 'yz', 'zx', or plane name).

name: catia_gsd_thick_surface
description: Turn a surface into a SOLID by adding thickness (Part Design ThickSurface). The solid is created in the active body.

name: catia_gsd_close_surface
description: Turn a closed (watertight) surface into a SOLID (Part Design CloseSurface). The solid is created in the active body.

name: catia_create_parameter
description: Create a user parameter on the active Part, or set its value if it already exists. Types: length (mm), angle (deg), real, integer, string, boolean. Parameters can then drive features through formulas.

name: catia_set_formula
description: Create or update a formula driving a parameter of the active Part. The expression uses CATIA syntax, with parameter paths in backticks, e.g. "`PartBody\\Pad.1\\FirstLimit\\Length` * 2" or "Thickness + 5mm". If a relation with the same name exists it is modified in place.

target_parameter.description: Parameter that receives the result (name or full path from catia_get_parameters)

name: catia_list_relations
description: List the relations of the active Part (formulas, design tables, rules, checks) with their bodies and comments. Optional substring filter.

name: catia_delete_relation
description: Delete a relation (formula, design table, rule, check) of the active Part by name.

name: catia_create_design_table
description: Create a design table from an Excel or text sheet (absolute path on the CATIA machine) and associate its columns to parameters of the active Part by name. The sheet's column headers must match the parameter names given in 'parameters'.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xls/.xlsx/.txt sheet on the CATIA machine

parameters.description: Parameter names to associate (one per sheet column with the same header)

copy_mode.description: Copy the sheet data into the part (default true) rather than linking the file

name: catia_measure_distance
description: Measure the minimum distance between two geometry elements. Returns distance in mm. Elements resolve by tree name (features, sketches, e.g. 'Pad.1', 'Sketch.2') or by indexed topology ('Face.N' / 'Edge.N' as enumerated by catia_list_faces / catia_list_edges on the final solid).

element1.description: Name of first element (feature, face, edge, point)

name: catia_get_inertia
description: Get inertia properties of the active part: volume (mm3 and cm3), surface area (mm2 and cm2), center of gravity (mm), mass in kg (if a density is passed), inertia matrix (kg.m2, from the material density defined in CATIA). All values are converted server-side from CATIA's internal MKS measurement units.

density.description: Material density in kg/m3 (optional, for mass calculation)

name: catia_get_bounding_box
description: Get the bounding box of the active part from a vertex sweep of the final shape, in mm. Exact for planar-faced solids; curved faces may extend beyond the reported bounds (stated in the result).

name: catia_get_parameters
description: List all user-defined and computed parameters of the active part. Includes dimensions, formulas, and design tables.

name: catia_set_parameter
description: Set the value of a named parameter in the active part. Useful for parametric design modifications.

name: catia_update_part
description: Force update/rebuild of the active part. Recalculates all features.

name: catia_pad
description: Create a Pad (extrusion) from the last sketch. Extrudes a 2D profile into a 3D solid along the normal to the sketch plane.

symmetric.description: If true, extrude equally on both sides (total = height)

sketch_name.description: Name of sketch to use. If not specified, uses the last created sketch.

name: catia_pocket
description: Create a Pocket (cut extrusion) from the last sketch. Removes material by extruding a 2D profile inward.

symmetric.description: If true, mirrored extent: cuts equally on both sides (reliable on V5-6R2020, where DirectionOrientation may not flip the cut side)

sketch_name.description: Name of sketch to use. If not specified, uses the last sketch.

name: catia_shaft
description: Create a Shaft (revolution) from the last sketch. Revolves a 2D profile around an axis to create a solid of revolution. The revolution axis is the sketch's own V direction (AbsoluteAxis); do not draw an axis line (rejected on V5-6R2020).

angle.description: Revolution angle in degrees (default: 360 for full revolution)

name: catia_groove
description: Create a Groove (revolution cut). Removes material by revolving a 2D profile around an axis.

name: catia_fillet
description: Add a fillet (rounded edge) to one or more edges of the current solid. Specify the radius and the edge names or feature to fillet.

edge_name.description: Indexed edge to fillet ('Edge.N' from catia_list_edges). Omit to fillet all edges of the last feature.

name: catia_chamfer
description: Add a chamfer (beveled edge) to an edge of the current solid.

edge_name.description: Indexed edge to chamfer ('Edge.N' from catia_list_edges). Omit to chamfer all edges of the last feature.

name: catia_hole
description: Create a Hole feature at a point in the active sketch. Supports simple, tapered, counterbored, and countersunk holes.

sketch_name.description: Sketch containing the hole center point

name: catia_rect_pattern
description: Create a Rectangular Pattern of the last feature. Duplicates a feature in a grid along two directions.

dir1_edge.description: Edge giving direction 1 ('Edge.N' from catia_list_edges). Pass with dir2_edge, two ADJACENT edges sharing a corner (CATIA rejects parallel directions). Omit both to let CATIA pick defaults.

dir2_edge.description: Edge giving direction 2 ('Edge.N', adjacent to dir1_edge)

dir1_count.description: Number of instances in first direction

dir2_count.description: Number of instances in second direction (default: 1)

feature_name.description: Name of the feature to pattern. Defaults to last feature.

name: catia_circ_pattern
description: Create a Circular Pattern of the last feature. Duplicates a feature around a central axis.

center.description: Point [x, y, z] in mm the rotation axis passes through (default origin)

count.description: Number of instances around the circle

angular_spacing.description: Angular spacing in degrees (default: equal spacing = 360/count)

feature_name.description: Feature to pattern. Defaults to last feature.

name: catia_user_pattern
description: Create a User Pattern: copies of a feature placed on the points of a sketch (the most flexible pattern, e.g. arbitrary bolt layouts). Draw the points with catia_sketch_point in a dedicated sketch and close it; pass its name from catia_close_sketch. Points must not coincide with the seed feature's position.

count.description: Number of instances (number of locating points)

sketch_name.description: REQUIRED: name of the points sketch as reported by catia_close_sketch (e.g. 'Sketch.3')

feature_name.description: Feature to pattern. Defaults to last feature.

name: catia_mirror
description: Mirror a feature or body about a plane. Creates a symmetric copy of the geometry.

name: catia_shell
description: Create a Shell feature: hollows out a solid leaving walls of specified thickness. Optionally remove faces to create openings.

faces_to_remove.description: REQUIRED: indexed faces to remove and open ('Face.N' from catia_list_faces); the first one anchors the shell.

name: catia_draft
description: Add a Draft Angle to faces for mold-release purposes. Tapers faces by a given angle relative to a pulling direction.

face_name.description: REQUIRED: indexed face to draft ('Face.N' from catia_list_faces)

name: catia_thickness
description: Add or remove thickness from faces of a solid. Offsets faces inward or outward.

offset.description: Thickness offset in mm (positive = outward, negative = inward)

face_name.description: REQUIRED: indexed face to thicken ('Face.N' from catia_list_faces)

name: catia_delete_feature
description: Delete a feature by name (e.g. 'Pocket.2') in any body of the active part, then update the part. Features depending on it end up in error and are reported.

name: catia_list_features
description: List all features in the active Part Body with their names and types.

name: catia_list_edges
description: List the edges of the final solid shape as indexed names (Edge.N). These indices feed catia_measure_distance; for fillet/chamfer targeting see each tool's own contract.

name: catia_list_faces
description: List the faces of a body's final solid shape as indexed names (Face.N) for catia_measure_distance, shell, draft, thickness and face-driven drawing views. Defaults to the main body; pass body_name to enumerate another body (use the same body_name in catia_drawing_add_view).

body_name.description: Body to enumerate (default: the part's main body)

name: catia_create_sketch
description: Create a new 2D sketch on a reference plane (xy, yz, or zx). The sketch is opened for editing. You must close it with catia_close_sketch before creating 3D features.

name: catia_close_sketch
description: Close the active sketch and return to Part Design. Must be called after finishing sketch geometry before applying 3D features.

name: catia_sketch_line
description: Draw a line in the active sketch from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2). Coordinates in mm.

name: catia_sketch_rectangle
description: Draw a rectangle in the active sketch defined by two opposite corners. Creates 4 lines forming a closed profile. Coordinates in mm.

name: catia_sketch_centered_rectangle
description: Draw a rectangle centered at (cx, cy) with given width and height. Coordinates and dimensions in mm.

name: catia_sketch_circle
description: Draw a circle in the active sketch. Coordinates and radius in mm.

name: catia_sketch_arc
description: Draw a circular arc defined by center, radius, and start/end angles (degrees). Angles are measured counter-clockwise from the positive X axis.

name: catia_sketch_spline
description: Draw a spline through a list of control points. Each point is [x, y] in mm.

points.description: List of [x, y] control points in mm

closed.description: Whether to close the spline (default: false)

name: catia_sketch_point
description: Create a point in the active sketch. Coordinates in mm.

name: catia_sketch_constraint
description: Add a dimensional constraint to the active sketch. Supported types: distance, radius, angle, coincidence, tangent, perpendicular, parallel, horizontal, vertical, fix.

value.description: Constraint value (mm or degrees). Required for distance, radius, angle.

geometry_index_1.description: Index of first geometry element (1-based, from sketch geometry list)

geometry_index_2.description: Index of second geometry element (for relational constraints)

name: catia_sketch_get_geometry
description: List all geometry elements in the active sketch with their indices and types.
